requests.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: rear-view game character cutout source painting on a genuinely transparent background. Input image 1 is the accepted Cinder Droplet FRONT DESIGN REFERENCE, not an edit target; preserve it unchanged in the project. Primary request: paint the matching REAR three-quarter view of this exact small armored molten tentacled creature, facing upper-right away from the viewer on a 2:1 isometric board. Same apparent size, body proportions, low stance, dark cooled-lava tendrils, orange molten fissures, angular broken iron cap with rust edges and single swept triangular spike. From the rear there are NO eyes or face; show a coherent dark crusted back with sparse matching fissures beneath the same cap. Grounded rounded body with the same short spreading tendril contacts. Match the reference's painterly pixel-readable detail, hard dark outlines, subdued charcoal/umber iron and localized orange glow exactly; avoid a smooth vector style, cute mascot, humanoid limbs, weapons or redesign. Entire creature fits a square image with generous transparent margins. No floor, cast shadow, checker pattern, lettering, border, new props or extra creatures. This will be uniformly registered to the accepted 255x255 canvas after generation; do not draw a layout sheet.
requests.reference_roles: Accepted front_original.png is the identity and anatomy reference; generation of a matching rear view.
requests.disposition: Selected rear paint; generated RGB checkerboard excluded by recorded ownership matte.
